Vendored:    git submodule at xalan-test-src/ + generated manifest.json
Format:      per test = stylesheet (.xsl) + source (.xml) + expected (.out,
             the OASIS "gold" serialized tree). manifest.json lists
             {name, category, stylesheet, source, expected, description}
             with paths relative to this directory. Same schema the
             existing third_party/testing/xslt/ corpus uses.
Test count:  1690 triples across 35 categories (every conf/ category that
             has an xsl+xml+gold triple).
Runner:      bin/linux-x86_64/xslt_runner --base third_party/testing/xslt1-xalan
             (the same F*-extracted XSLT_Transform oracle as the default
             suite; --base just points it at this manifest.)
